description: Source code for the RunDex2Oat class, which manages the execution of the dex2oat compiler in the Android build system. It includes methods for setting up command-line arguments based on system properties and input files, and for executing the compiler process.

classes.name: RunDex2Oat
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring and executing the dex2oat compiler with appropriate flags based on system properties and input files.

methods.name: RunDex2Oat
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with the path to the dex2oat binary and an execution helper.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up command-line arguments for dex2oat based on input files, system properties, and compilation options.

methods.name: PrepareBootImageFlags
methods.description: Adds arguments related to boot image configuration, depending on whether JIT Zygote is used.

methods.name: PrepareInputFileFlags
methods.description: Configures input and output file arguments for dex2oat.

methods.name: PrepareCompilerConfigFlags
methods.description: Sets compiler-related flags such as instruction set, compiler filter, debug info, and system properties.

methods.name: PrepareCompilerRuntimeAndPerfConfigFlags
methods.description: Configures runtime and performance flags like CPU set, thread count, and memory options.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes the dex2oat process with the prepared arguments.

methods.name: AddArg
methods.description: Adds a command-line argument to the process.

methods.name: AddRuntimeArg
methods.description: Adds a runtime-specific argument to the process.

methods.name: GetBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean system property value.

methods.name: MapPropertyToArg
methods.description: Maps a system property to a command-line argument using a format string.

methods.name: MapPropertyToArgWithBackup
methods.description: Maps a system property to a command-line argument, with a backup property if the primary is empty.
